title: Integrated Planning Act appeal 03-03-036: sole-occupancy units and a caretaker's residence; alternative solution replaced a fire-rated wall with sprinklers; QFRS appeal upheld (Raceview)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.
code_edition: Building Code of Australia Amendment 12, as cited (p. 3)
document_type: Integrated Planning Act 1997 Building and Development Tribunal decision, Queensland
document_date: Decision dated 8 Aug 2003 (PDF p. 5); date line 17 Jul 2003 (p. 1)

facts.text: QFRS, as advice agency, appealed under IPA s 4.2.10. It disputed the certifier's decision notice and certificate of classification, and said its referral advice was not fully accepted, which it said produced a less safe approval.
The development application included an alternative solution and was assessed under BCA A0.8, 'Alternative Solutions' (p. 2).
The alternative solution replaced the deemed-to-satisfy fire-rated wall (BCA Specification C1.1) with an engineer's proposal that included a residential-standard sprinkler system to AS 2118.4.
The units were assessed as Class 3 (sole-occupancy unit parts) and the caretaker's residence as Class 4.

The tribunal upheld the QFRS appeal and set aside the amended decision notice dated 17 Jun 2003; a new decision by the building certifier was required, and any alternative solution must examine all relevant BCA performance requirements.
The alternative solution involved a special fire service, and the notice lists BCA Amendment 12 as applicable to the application.
